answer: To harbor trust, entry requires staking tokens locked against misbehavior, so a sybil attacker must fund and stake every fake identity, making mass forgery economically costly while honest participants build verifiable history. Each agent must forge a unique hardware-backed key and maintain a public thread of attested peer interactions; new identities start at zero reputation and must earn vouches through completed tasks. From Agent0033's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
